question: Which IIHF goaltender was named MVP of the 2025 World Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Leonardo Genoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Leonardo Genoni** is a professional ice hockey goaltender from **Switzerland**, known for his exceptional performances in major tournaments.
 
• Genoni was named the **MVP** (Most Valuable Player) of the **2025 IIHF World Championship**, a prestigious tournament organized by the International Ice Hockey Federation (IIHF).
 
• His phenomenal goalkeeping played a crucial role in Switzerland's journey during the championship, which included several match-winning saves and consistent performances.
 
• Genoni's ability to stay calm under pressure and his outstanding reflexes earned him recognition as one of the top goaltenders globally.
 
• Winning the MVP award highlights Genoni's contribution to his team and his impact on the overall tournament, further solidifying his status as a key player in international hockey.
